title: Sunpatches on the Orchard Wall
description: Travel from the country lane into orchard shade, then climb its stone boundary into sunlit terraces. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

rooms.name: The country lane
rooms.lesson: Vault the orchard’s low boundary stones. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The orchard outskirts
rooms.lesson: Cross between the first tree terraces. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: Inside the orchard
rooms.lesson: Thread the branch passages in the shade. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The old stone wall
rooms.lesson: Climb the wall’s changing faces. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The upper sun terraces
rooms.lesson: Wide terraces open into the light. Follow the weight as it swings away.
